rules.title: Gather evidence before modelling a living taxon
require: Fetch or bind the taxon’s authority sources (ALA, NSL, GBIF, traits, ecology).
Seal sourced Turtle/N3 to a .q42 with synth_compile_q42.
Query the vault (query_sparql vault_path) so the corpus is inspectable.
Only then invoke botanical/FSPM/assemble morphisms inside synth_produce_present.
